narration: P T E Academic, Read Aloud. Stop reading word by word! Here's a five-step formula to improve your fluency, pronunciation, and reading skills. Step one: Preview. Identify difficult words before speaking, so you don't hesitate when reading. Step two: Chunk. Divide long sentences into meaningful phrases, allowing your speech to flow naturally. Step three: Stress. Emphasise important content words, rather than giving equal emphasis to every word. Step four: Connect. Link words smoothly instead of stopping between individual words. Step five: Finish. Maintain a steady pace and complete your final phrase clearly. Remember: preview, chunk, stress, connect, and finish. Practise these five steps to deliver a more confident and natural P T E Read Aloud response.
